title: Sample and liquidity measures
note: Datastream security-year inventory: 1,055,142 observations, 99,100 vendor company records and 90 jurisdictions, 2000-2025. All three measures are jointly available for 636,960 stock-years in 86 jurisdictions. Estimation uses fixed company cohorts and smaller documented country comparisons. Higher values indicate less liquidity. Logs and fractions are not percentage changes.

title: Disclosure families and information audiences
note: The main pool comprises ten identified public-disclosure families; eight support following-year comparisons and six support years 1-3. Confidential tax reporting is shown separately and enters a combined disclosure sensitivity. Recorded country counts include implemented phases through 2025 across the wider source register, not only countries with market data. Dashes denote unsupported estimates or exclusion from the public-only weight. The calendar is not a census of all historical disclosure laws; broader governance and register categories remain in the 17-family appendix.

note: Weighted linear probability models. N denotes country-family-year rows; C countries; F families. Cells show coefficient, country-clustered SE and q across all 64 planned coefficient attempts. Predictor units match Table 13. The outcome is whether the policy is in place (Table 14) or first adoption while still at risk (Table 15). Country-family effects remove persistent national policy-family differences; family-year effects additionally absorb common family adoption waves. Adding family-year effects was declared after initial within-year results were seen; both designs and every coefficient are retained. LPM coefficients are probability-point associations and can imply out-of-range fitted probabilities. They are not odds ratios or causal peer effects.
